failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days remains below -12.0% or declines further, despite WORKPLACES remaining stable or improving.

failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility reverses to below -35% in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC fails to show positive week-on-week change despite transit improvement.

failure_condition: PARKS mobility recovers above -5% while RETAIL_REC remains below -12%, indicating substitution does not occur.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines further despite both GROCERY_PHARM stabilization and TRANSIT improvement, indicating the interaction does not drive retail recovery.
